item.title: My OSCP Journey - Tips, Tricks and Cheat Sheets
item.description: Welcome! I’m excited to introduce a project I’ve been working on during my preparation for the Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP) certification. On my GitBook, you’ll find: Detailed cheatsheets covering penetration testing methodologies. Useful commands and quick references. Lessons learned and practical tips from my OSCP journey. The goal is to provide a resource for anyone aiming to tackle and successfully pass this prestigious ethical hacking certification. item.title: CVE-2020-13654
item.description: XWiki Platform < 12.8 - Stored Cross Site Scripting (XSS) CVE Detail In XWiki Platform before version 12.8, certain fields like “Company” in the user profile editing section are vulnerable to Stored Cross Site Scripting (XSS) attacks due to improper escaping. Vulnerability Summary Product CVE CVSSv3 Score CWE XWiki CVE-2020-13654 7.5 (High) CWE-116 Exploitation Steps This vulnerability allows an attacker to inject malicious scripts into certain fields (e.g., “Company”) in the user profile section, which are subsequently executed in the browser of any user accessing the page.
